EmailTemplate.subject: OPRT - Filters
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for your email. Insperity Organizational Planning offers the ability to create custom filters that can be used to hide or “mute” boxes that do not meet the filter’s criteria while viewing boxes in the Workspace.
You can view our job aid here for a guide on the creation and usage of filters. If you have any additional questions or if I can be of further assistance, please let me know.
Thank you,
